source: Mix of openFDA-verified label data (fetched live via ingestion/fetch_regulatory.py) and hand-curated general knowledge -- see each entry's `status` field.
note: Entries with status 'verified_via_openfda' had their indications_and_usage text pulled live from openFDA's /drug/label.json (confirms the drug/brand is on file with FDA and quotes its actual approved indication). Entries with status 'needs_verification' are drawn from the ingested literature corpus (see literature_dmd.json, PMID 40817386, 34120909, 36963652) plus general knowledge -- ataluren specifically has no openFDA record because it's EU-only (EMA conditional authorization, not FDA-approved).

approval_events.verify_against: openFDA drug label + FDA approval letter

approval_events.safety_signal: Post-market reports of acute liver failure deaths in 2025 (per PMID 40817386); full approval reported despite not meeting phase 3 primary/secondary outcomes
approval_events.verify_against: openFDA drug label + FAERS adverse event reports + FDA safety communications

approval_events.openfda_indications_snippet: VYONDYS 53 is indicated for the treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) in patients who have a confirmed mutation of the DMD gene that is amenable to exon 53 skipping. This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on an increase in dystrophin production in skeletal muscle observed in patients treated with VYONDYS 53.

VILTEPSO is indicated for the treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) in patients who have a confirmed mutation of the DMD gene that is amenable to exon 53 skipping. This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on an increase in dystrophin production in skeletal muscle observed in patients treated with VILTEPSO.

AMONDYS 45 is indicated for the treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) in patients who have a confirmed mutation of the DMD gene that is amenable to exon 45 skipping. This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on an increase in dystrophin production in skeletal muscle observed in patients treated with AMONDYS 45.
